center.locator: Arithmetic centroid of the 32-vertex convex hull of the sd1500 surface-detector stations (computed for this map)
center.note: Map centre only; not a claim about any structure. precision_m is set loosely because this is a naive hull-vertex centroid, not a claim about a physical point.

levels.name: Surface
levels.note: The entire array is at the surface; there is no underground level.

name: Pierre Auger Observatory: Malargüe surface-detector array
notes: map-center-far warning is expected and accepted: the map centre is the array's own geometric centroid (about 40 km from site:malargue-auger, the Observatory's administrative address in the town of Malargue).

Every active surface-detector station is drawn individually: 1587 main-array stations in 20 north-to-south bands of 79 or 80 and 49 infill-only stations, from sdMap.csv in the Auger Open Data release 3 (CC BY-SA 4.0). The map format has no multi-point type, so each station is a 3.6 m square marker (the tank diameter) in a MultiPolygon of at most 80 stations.

The four fluorescence-detector buildings (Los Leones, Los Morados, Loma Amarilla, Coihueco) are not drawn: no fetched source states their coordinates. Overpass (extract 2026-10-25T11:11:23Z) has Pierre Auger Observatory communication-tower nodes at (-35.496078, -69.4498211) on Cerro Los Leones, (-35.1143142, -69.6000234) and at the Malargue campus, and the peaks Cerro Los Leones and Loma Amarilla, but no fluorescence building footprint, and a tower is not the building; the Open Data fdPixelMap.csv gives pixel pointing only and the Open Data event display is a binary Unity build.
geometry:auger-sd750-infill-boundary: the 71 stations flagged sd750 enclose 29.3 km2, not the "23.5 km2, 61-detector" infill of the Observatory paper; no check is asserted (unresolved.
The Auger Open Data page does not state the UTM zone or datum of sdMap.csv; zone 19 south on WGS 84 is this work's reading (the numbers only fall at Malargue in zone 19).

summary.plain: The Pierre Auger Observatory's array of about 1,600 water-filled detector tanks on the Pampa Amarilla near Malargue, Argentina, with every working station drawn at its surveyed position, plus the outline of the main array and of the denser infill. The four fluorescence telescope sites are not drawn.
summary.technical: One local map for facility:pierre-auger-observatory. 1587 main-array (1500 m grid) and 49 infill-only (750 m grid) stations are the northing/easting columns of sdMap.csv in the Auger Open Data release 3 (read as UTM 19S, WGS 84), drawn as 3.6 m markers; convex hulls of the active main array (3098 km2 against the quoted 3000 km2) and of the sd750 stations are computed outlines. The four fluorescence-detector buildings are not placed.
